name: AI News Curator V3: Intelligence + Research Fallback + Multi-Platform

parameters.content:
## AI News Curator V3

🧠 AI gate + next-candidate retry
🔬 Research fallback (HN Algolia)
📊 Enrichment: sentiment, entities, credibility
🎯 A/B headline pick
♻️ Repurpose: X thread, Discord, newsletter
📈 Analytics in workflow static data
🚨 Breaking priority flag

Placeholders: @YOUR_TELEGRAM_CHANNEL, YOUR_LINKEDIN_PERSON_URN, YOUR_DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL

## 🔬 Research Fallback
If AI rejects all RSS picks:
1) Fetch live HN Algolia signals
2) AI picks best story
3) Enrich + post anyway

Also runs when zero RSS matches.

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { status: 'skipped', reason: 'RSS empty/rejected and research fallback found nothing post-worthy', at: new Date().toISOString() } }];
const j = $input.first().json; return [{ json: { ...j, publishMode: j.priority === 'breaking' || j.breaking ? 'instant_priority' : 'scheduled' } }];
